estilo: Ordinary old house interior and façade in daylight from the windows or the street, worn objects, dust and cement grey on the floor, a little off-center framing, nothing posed.

claudio.desc: Claudio, a 58-year-old Latin American bricklayer with short curly black hair going gray, a gray-stubbled beard, warm brown eyes and tanned weathered skin, wearing a bright orange crew-neck t-shirt with a little gray cement dust and a yellow tape measure clipped to his belt

marta.desc: Doña Marta, a 70-year-old Latin American widow with short white hair, wearing a lilac cardigan and an apron

lugares_fijos.sala: Doña Marta's living room: mint-green plaster walls, red clay tile floor, windows with white iron bars, a dark wooden wardrobe and sideboard, a small wall clock
lugares_fijos.fachada: the front façade of the old Latin American house: mint-green wall with old paint peeling in sheets near the floor, a wooden door with iron grille, a small cement step
lugares_fijos.cocina: the small kitchen of the house: beige floor tiles, white wall tiles, a steel sink under a window with white iron bars, a wooden table
lugares_fijos.pasillo: the hallway of the house: red clay tile floor, mint-green plaster walls, a row of framed family photos
lugares_fijos.mostrador: the counter of a small neighborhood hardware store: glass counter with screws and small items inside, wooden shelves behind full of paint cans and rolls of tape

identidad: Preserve the exact identity, face, short curly black hair going gray, gray-stubbled beard, age and skin tone of the man in the reference photograph. He is a 58-year-old Latin American bricklayer wearing a bright orange crew-neck t-shirt with a little gray cement dust and a yellow tape measure clipped to his belt.
